structured_output.title: Ingress-shim annotation feature may apply if ingress-shim deployed
structured_output.content: The new `--extra-certificate-annotations` flag is an ingress-shim option that copies annotations from Ingress objects to Certificate objects. Your environment has Certificate CRDs (certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]) installed and in use, which is the target of this feature. However, the environment summary does not explicitly state whether ingress-shim is deployed or configured. Verify: (1) whether ingress-shim is enabled in your cert-manager deployment, (2) whether you use Ingress resources that need annotation copying, and (3) if so, whether you need to set `--extra-certificate-annotations` with specific annotation keys to copy.
